main.description: List videos newest first. Scoped to a single repo when `repo` is supplied; otherwise lists videos across every indexed repo. Returns hydrated video views with author info and view counts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

repo.description: DID or handle of the repo whose videos to list. Omit to list videos globally across all repos.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page, if any.

errors.description: No repo indexed at the supplied DID.
errors.name: RepoNotFound
